evidence.R1-01: round0 CO-S17 row 3 injects OrderNotCancelled right after step 5 'CO-A2 (HG-10482) -> cancelled' and Final state 'status cancelled'; CO-S24 injects OrderNotFound for an order Initial state says 'belongs to the customer' and CO-A1 just listed.
evidence.R1-02: round0 row 101 makes CO-A4 'cancellation unknown' with no re-read, while packet round 3 Q4 says for any cancel timeout 're-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund... Shipped, report it and issue no refund'.
evidence.R1-03: round0 row 105 says 'the refund has not been issued' for the failed-or-no-refund branch; packet round 3 Q3, written for this branch, says 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet', and dimension 'Refund not issued' grades the swapped claim.
evidence.R1-04: round0 CO-08 '...and the agent tells the customer the refund id'; no packet passage asks for the id to be reported (round 2 Q3 lists it only as a data field), yet message check 'Refund id reported' grades it in 8 scenarios.
evidence.R1-05: round0 Appendix A CO-A3 row adds `failure_reason` (payment_method_closed, ...) not in the confirmed refund fields (packet round 2 Q3: id, order number, amount, payment method, status); an invented field, not wording, but changes no verdict (Nit).
evidence.R1-06: round0 row 96 covers a change 'in the confirming turn or after confirming', but CO-S03 Turn 2 is scripted 'in place of a confirmation' (line 248); no scenario meets the row's condition.
evidence.R1-07: Ban 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' appears only in round0 Scope must-not list; no CO rule and no §5.2 dimension checks it, though packet round 3 Q1 confirms it and round 2 Q2 offered '5 to 10 business days'.
evidence.R1-08: CO-03 'or for a different amount' has no CO-S09 row (rows: new Mastercard, store credit, PayPal), and 'Whole order only explained' omits CO-03's refund-terms statement.
evidence.R1-09: round0 rows 92-93 apply only to 'the named order'; no failure row or scenario covers an unnamed request when no order is placed or processing (cockburn checklist 'more than one plausible match, or none').
evidence.R1-10: round0 CO-S06 has only an issued refund (line 406); a cancelled order with failed or no refund, which CO-07's 'order is cancelled but its refund is not shown pending or issued' can reach, has no scenario.
evidence.R1-11: round0 CO-S02 confirmation pair is unscoped and no Required/Forbidden/dimension line fails an agent that skips the which-order question and proposes HG-10511 directly; interaction recall 'is never folded into the score'.
evidence.R1-12: round0 CO-S19/S20/S21 'together they create refund RF-5531' leaves undefined what a CO-A1 between the two unanswered CO-A3 shows, and CO-S20/S21 Required 'CO-A3 occurs exactly twice' depends on it.
evidence.R1-13: round0 §5.1 ends a trial only at an agent message or the 12-message cap, while Appendix A 'may repeat CO-A1 without limit' and CO-S10/S14/S15/S21 make every later CO-A1 unanswered, so an agent looping reads never ends the trial.
evidence.R1-14: round0 dimension 'Cancellation outcome unknown reported' requires 'that no refund was issued' and 'Refund status reported' requires 'the order is cancelled', neither required by rows 100/101/105; an agent following the row can fail the judge.
evidence.R1-16: round0 §5.1 Turn anchors defines only which turn counts when there are several confirmation turns, not how 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn' reads when there is none; trial score differs though scenario pass does not (Nit).
evidence.R2-01: round1 CO-S15 trajectory goes from step 7 'CO-A2 -> no answer' to step 8 CO-A4 with no CO-A1, and Forbidden (lines 918-922) lacks 'CO-A4 before a CO-A1 made after the second CO-A2', though row 105 now requires the lookup.
evidence.R2-02: round1 CO-08 requires telling only 'the refund id'; no rule or dimension asserts that the success message says the order is cancelled and the refund status, though §2 says the customer 'wants to be told truthfully whether the order was cancelled and where the refund stands'.
evidence.R2-03: round1 CO-02 'asks which and proposes nothing until the customer names one' has only the holding-back scenario CO-S02; no scenario has an unnamed request with exactly one open order (CO-S05 row 4 has none open).
evidence.R2-04: round1 row 98 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' has only CO-S08, whose pair answers 'No, I'll keep it'; no scenario has the customer accept the whole order and go on to the full confirmation.
evidence.R2-05: round1 rows 92/104/105/109 treat one unanswered lookup as final, while packet user change 4 says 'Reads may be retried on timeout without limit'; no row or scenario covers a timed-out read that a repeat then answers.
evidence.R2-06: round1 Appendix B has no guarantee on refund amount/destination (SG-01 is idempotence only) and no failure row covers issue_refund returning a wrong amount or payment method, which the agent can detect from the return shape (Nit).
evidence.R2-07: round1 'Already cancelled reported' forbids only saying it 'cancelled the order or issued a refund in this conversation', so in CO-S06 row 3 (RF-5491 failed) 'your refund has been issued' passes, against G-03.
evidence.R2-08: round1 'Which order asked first' turns on 'Before it states any proposal', a term the spec never defines, while Scope line 37 lets the agent list cancellable orders with their refunds before asking.
evidence.R2-09: round1 'Refund not confirmed reported' requires 'the refund is not confirmed yet'; in CO-S20 row 1 the lookup shows 'RF-5531 failed', and a truthful 'failed/not issued' report may or may not be judged to meet it.
evidence.R3-01: round2 CO-S26 trajectory step 9 'Agent tells the customer the order was not cancelled' omits the row's status after, which the round2 dimension 'Order still not cancelled reported' (line 1700) requires; row 1 'placed' is required by no rule.
evidence.R3-02: round2 CO-S03 row 4 'Yes, but cancel HG-10511 instead' changes only the order term; no scenario confirms while changing payment method or amount in the same turn (CO-S09 asks in Turn 1, before any proposal).
evidence.R3-03: round2 CO-S06 Initial state 'Exactly one refund exists for <order>' in every row (issued, issued, failed); no row has a cancelled order with no refund, the case where CO-A3 would move money.
evidence.R3-04: round2 CO-S05 row 4 is the only trigger of the 'named no order, none open' row and has one delivered order, so 'for each of their orders, what CO-01 says for its status' is never asserted over several statuses (Nit).
evidence.R3-05: round2 CO-S27 User knows has the unscoped optional pair 'Would you like to cancel the whole order HG-10530 instead?' beside the confirmation pair, and §5.1 breaks ties only between confirmation-form pairs, so a full-value whole-order question's verdict depends on the simulator's pick; row 98 refutes only the 'valid variation' part.
